nodes.label: EMA Example Chart
nodes.description: Candlestick chart titled 'Скользящие средние EMA 50 и EMA 200' showing price action with two exponential moving averages: EMA 50 (blue line) and EMA 200 (red line) overlaid on green/red candlesticks. Price axis (Цена) ranges from ~1.078 to 1.090, x-axis shows ~120 time periods. Demonstrates EMA crossover concept in forex trading.

nodes.label: EMA 50 Line
nodes.description: Blue EMA 50 line responding faster to price changes, crosses above EMA 200 during the uptrend and peaks around period 95.

nodes.label: EMA 200 Line
nodes.description: Red EMA 200 line, slower-moving long-term trend indicator, steadily rising throughout the chart period from ~1.080 to ~1.083.

nodes.label: Candlestick Price Data
nodes.description: Green and red candlesticks showing forex price action, likely EUR/USD based on price range ~1.078-1.090, spanning ~120 periods.
